initialize_ConfigParser_from_config: parse a JSON config file and CLI arguments to set up experiment directories and logging
initialize_module_from_config: instantiate a module class by name from config using ConfigParser initialize method with keyword args
update_config_with_cli_options: update a nested config dictionary with CLI option values using _update_config helper function
access_nested_config_by_path: get or set values in a nested dictionary by a sequence of keys using _get_by_path and _set_by_path
get_logger_with_verbosity: get a Python logger with configurable verbosity levels WARNING, INFO, or DEBUG via get_logger method
